facts.text: POCSO: Kasaragod paediatrician **Dr P. Krishnan** (78) was sentenced to 47 years, running concurrently as **20 years**, for sexually assaulting a 15-year-old patient.

facts.text: About 4,000 women students at Aligarh Muslim University's Women's College were denied voting rights in the AMU Students' Union elections (scheduled 5 Nov, the first in 8 years), reviving a gender-representation debate that traces back to a 2012 committee formed under the Lyngdoh Committee framework.

facts.text: Jadavpur University ordered a probe after a first-year Arts student alleged molestation by a non-teaching staffer on campus; Vice-Chancellor Chiranjib Bhattacharjee ordered the inquiry.

facts.text: **Section 69** of the **Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita** separately punishes sexual intercourse obtained by deceitful means, such as a false promise of marriage, with up to **10 years** in jail.

facts.text: SC (Justice **B.V. Nagarathna**) held that a consensual relationship that later sours cannot be turned into a **rape** charge; rape must be reserved for real violence, coercion or manipulated consent (case from Keralam).

facts.text: Under the **Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006**, the minimum age is **18 for women and 21 for men**. Child labour below **14** is banned under the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 (amended 2016).

facts.text: Assam CM **Himanta Biswa Sarma** said 560+ people were arrested in a new crackdown on **child marriage**; the State claims an 81% drop in child marriages across 20 districts.
